component.name: ThreadView
component.summary: Inspect and export a 3D-printable threaded fastener

description.p: ThreadView is a small experimental Qt application for viewing and animating a 3D-printable threaded fastener. Users can rotate and zoom the model and save the included STL file for slicing and 3D printing.
The application is intentionally narrow in scope and is intended as a simple demonstration and niche utility rather than a general-purpose CAD or slicer application.
